reviews.text: The veterinarian is very kind to the animals, and they respond quickly to sudden changes in their condition, even without an appointment.

I was concerned about my cat's mouth pain, so I took her to this vet for the first time.

Because I had an appointment, there was almost no waiting time, and I was very grateful that it minimized stress and discomfort for my cat.

The reception staff and the doctor were all very kind, and the examination was very thorough. They listened carefully to what I had to say and explained everything clearly, addressing my concerns.

They also accurately suggested necessary tests and treatments, and never recommended any unnecessary treatments or tests. It was clear that they prioritized the animals' well-being over profit, and I felt that this was a very trustworthy hospital.

I've been to several animal hospitals before, but personally, this is the one I feel most comfortable entrusting my pet to. I would definitely recommend it to anyone needing to have their beloved family member treated here.

They have been taking care of my dog ​​since he was a puppy and have given me a lot of kind advice. The doctors and nurses are all very kind.
It's a very reassuring hospital to have nearby.
We will continue to rely on them, so thank you in advance.

This is the main branch of the cat hospital "Tom & Tabby Suginami," located in Nakano Fujimicho (Wada 1-chome, Suginami Ward). When my elderly cat was unwell, they performed a thorough examination using ultrasound and X-rays. I've had a lot of experience with veterinary clinics, but the branch cat hospital is also run by trustworthy doctors. I highly recommend it. There is no coin parking nearby, so be careful if you're driving. There is a coin parking lot nearby at the Nakano Fujimicho cat hospital.

I came to this clinic urgently because my regular doctor was closed.

The doctor was kind and listened attentively to my concerns.
I've been a patient here for over 10 years. The doctor and all the staff are incredibly kind and attentive. They treat my dog ​​gently and carefully, speaking to him kindly during examinations.
